metadata_caption: It pained me to cut the 2 hours of carefully putting up wallpaper into 1 second! 😂 backstory ::: While cleaning, Kay asked me to take a stuffed animal (named bun) to the nursery. I dropped off it off and realized just how bad the nursery had gotten. I knew that Kay was overwhelmed by the nursery, and even though that she wanted so badly to get it all set up, she felt defeated by how messy it had become. I knew that she was going to get her nails done in the afternoon, so I put a plan into action to clean up the nursery. I got out the boxes, opened them, and disposed of them! I put up the wallpaper, organized, and cleaned the room! It may not seem like much because of how fast it was shown, but it took hours! 😂 and I was a little sweaty (seen in the beginning). Kay finally came home and I rushed to the door to catch her reaction. She came in and saw how the room had been revived! She loved it so much and I think it revitalized her excitement for finishing the room! I am so glad that I’m able to do these little things for her when I get a smidge of free time! She deserves this and more because she’s been working so hard to grow our baby bean. Hopefully bean will be born soon and we can finally start using all of this baby stuff that we’ve collected! 😂❤️ #kayandtayofficial #couples #relationships #pregnant
